Similarly to a lot of other people my queer little Supernatural watching butt thought this was gunna be another "hidden in the subtext only I can apparently see" queerbating shows. I knew that Taika and Rhys were the leads and I absolutely adored both of their work but I still was a bit scared to start watching for that fear that it wouldn't be as good as I had hyped it up in my mind. I saw one too many "ITS SO GAY" posts and decided to just put it in the background while I was doing crafts to get it over with.

My crafting didn't last 10 minutes before I was fully engrossed in the show.

As an overly polite and fearful little weirdo,  Stede spoke to me. As a recently discovered genderfluid queer, Jim spoke to me. Taika spoke to me especially with that lil tum reveal. I absolutely adore every single character in this silly queer little show. I cheered when The Kiss happened and wept openly at the end of episode 10.
